messages:
emma: Quick experiment idea  couple short launch posts + a gated in-post CTA that grants 120 tokens on first sign-up vs a soft nudge that grants tokens after first API call. Goal: see which drives faster activation (24h) and higher prompt-pack usage.

carlos: Nice. Primary metric = activation_24h. Secondary = percent using prompt-pack, time-to-first-api, and landing->signup CTR.

bex (growth-eng): I can wire two cohorts. Variant A = gated CTA: sign-up to claim 120 tokens. Variant B = soft nudge: lightweight signup, tokens granted after first API call. Ill add routing flags and analytics.

olivia: Copy for gated CTA post: "Try it now  sign up to claim 120 starter tokens and 3 idea prompts." For soft nudge: "Start in seconds  lightweight signup, tokens after first try." Keep messaging test orthogonal.

emma: Measurement plan: utm=post_launch_nudge, cohort=post_a_vs_b; events = post_click, signup, tokens_granted, first_api_request, prompt_pack_used, activated_24h. Dashboard hourly first 24h.

bex (growth-eng): Routing rules: if email_domain in enterprise_allowlist => route to SDR follow-up after signup (separate flow). Others enter the A/B assignment. Ill drop the landing drafts in #marketing-drafts.

carlos: Also add a tiny benchmark snippet in the blog post: "Starter prompt median latency ~210ms, est cost $0.02 per 1k tokens" as a trust signal. Replace with measured numbers post-smoke.

emma: Timeline  landing + two post variants live Tue AM, trafficing Wed morning, measure conversion in real time. Quick post-launch check Thu morning.

launch-bot: Reminder  two post variants scheduled Wed 09:00. :calendar:

bex (growth-eng): I'll instrument events: post_variant_a_click, post_variant_b_click, tokens_claimed_post, prompt_used_post.

emma: Great. After the experiment, run cohort compare: activation_24h uplift, prompt_pack adoption, net new paid signups 30d. Reconvene for results next week.

everyone: +1
